## Build from source {#build-from-source}

For the current development source, use Python 3.12 and a C++17 toolchain. Clone the development branch, then sync the locked environment and build the package:

```bash
git clone --branch codex/r2-jax-only-surface --single-branch https://github.com/NCUPHY-LTLab/scnsim.git
cd scnsim
uv sync --locked
uv build
```

For user installation after release, use `uv add scnsim`. The [Engineer setup guide](../examples/engineer/setup.qmd) covers notebook environment and platform details.

For public component models, start with the [Component Authoring Contract](component-authoring.qmd). For user workflows, begin with the [Engineer course](index.qmd).
